deltaBI.texto: Delta BI is the platform I built. I connect your company's data and build dashboards that cross-reference the information, so you understand your figures. Every client has access to Delta BI.

parrafos: I'm Daniel Villegas. I work as an outsourced finance director under the Delta Fractional brand.

I was an in-house finance director and finance manager at industrial, commercial, technology and public sector companies. Before that I worked nearly eight years in the securities market and in development banking.
M.Sc. in International Finance (EADA, Barcelona) and Business Administration (Pontificia Universidad Javeriana).
That experience is what I put at the service of companies that need a finance director, but not full time.

diagnostico.h2: Do you know which line of your business makes you money?
diagnostico.texto: I reconcile the information, measure the profitability of each business unit and project the cash. Result: prioritized findings and a 90-day plan.

items.r: From COP 2 M per month, depending on company size and type of service.

items.p: Do you only work in Manizales?
items.r: No. I'm based in Manizales and have nationwide coverage.

items.p: Does access to Delta BI cost extra?
items.r: No. Access to Delta BI is included in the service.

items.p: What happens to the models when the work ends?
items.r: The models I deliver are auditable and remain in the company's hands.
